 In pics: Janhvi Kapoor, Ananya Panday attend Diwali Puja at Karan Johar's office
 ANI | 
 Updated: Nov 07, 2026 17:53 IST 
 ANI News
 Join our Whatsapp channel 
 Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], November 7 (ANI): Filmmaker Karan Johar hosted a Diwali puja at his Dharma Productions office in Mumbai on Saturday, which saw several members of the film industry in attendance.
Dressed in traditional ethnic outfits, Ananya Panday arrived at the venue with her mother, Bhavna Pandey. Janhvi Kapoor was also spotted at the puja, looking elegant in a beautiful ombre-shaded saree. She happily posed for the shutterbugs.
Among other celebrities who attended the celebrations were Ananya Birla, Lakshya, Wamiqa Gabbi and Shanaya Kapoor, among others.
Earlier in the day, Karan took to Instagram and extended Diwali wishes to all. He also shared pictures with his children, Yash and Roohi. 
"My (heart) My world…My blessing…Shukrana to the universe for completing me with Roohi and Yash… we are blessed to have our mothers blessings… happy Diwali to all you from us," he captioned the post. 
           View this post on Instagram                       A post shared by Karan Johar (@karanjohar) 
The five-day Diwali celebrations begin with Dhanteras on November 6, followed by Choti Diwali on November 7. The main festival and Lakshmi Puja will take place on November 8, followed by Govardhan Puja on November 9 and Bhai Dooj on November 10. (ANI)
